items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: they had Rene, they had Rene, that, myself, Edna Mitchell, Joe Rene, Chester Lazard, Chester Lazard, and Henry Hardin... It was ten, ten pieces.

ctx.x: What instrument? Did he play sax?

He played sax, yeah. And they had this other boy playing bass, what is his name there? Lazard. Chester Lazard. Chester Lazard. Chester Lazard, yeah. Chester Lazard. Chester Lazard, yeah. He was playing bass, yeah.
That was a pretty big band, that wasn't it?
